Message:
“I’m the worst kind of
human being out there.
As my hometown crumbled
before my very eyes,
I made a wish,

but it had nothing to do
with feeling scared,
or wanting to save everyone...

It was, ‘I want to turn this
beautiful scene into a painting.’”

“So I figured, if this power
ended up killing me,
I’d be getting
just what I deserved.

That is...until you said those
words to me, Fia—
‘What a pretty light.’”

But now, I’m glad
I painted on that canvas.

Just look at how
beautiful it turned out.”

Once Yubera’s power had
finally calmed down,
she left for a faraway
sanatorium to get treated.

All that was left in her empty
house was one single painting.

It was...a depiction of a city
on the verge of being destroyed...
A painting so beautiful,
it was terrifying.

My hand found its way to
the shriveled black flower.

This isn’t the way you’d
hoped things’d turn out, huh.

But after abandoning my family,
I just knew I wouldn’t be able
to live with myself
if I did it again to a friend.
And besides...I finally get it now.
I wanna live just like you did.

I wanna take the kindness
you left me with,
and save others,
like you did for me.

To me, that’s what it means
to “live as a human.”
